<!-- en -->
v0.1.1-rc.2 is the second prerelease of v0.1.1. It fixes Codex collection failures on subagent sessions, restores ZCode provider display names after an upstream cache-format change, and ships a logging-governance pass: expected-path chatter is removed or aggregated into one summary per scan, and daemon fallback stdout/stderr now land in the `logs/` directory instead of standalone `daemon.out.log` / `daemon.err.log` files. Because prereleases are not selected by default, update explicitly with `token-usage update --version v0.1.1-rc.2`.

### Fixed
- Codex: collection no longer fails on subagent sessions whose `session_meta.payload.source` is an object (e.g. `{"subagent":{...}}`) — both string and object shapes are accepted, and a session-meta payload with unexpected field types now degrades to ID-only extraction instead of dropping the whole session. Sessions previously recorded as "missing session ID" errors are collected after retrying
- ZCode: provider display names are restored when `bots-model-cache.v2.json` uses the version 2 schema (provider names moved from the top-level `providers` array into `workspaceConfigOptions`); both schemas are parsed and an unparsable file still degrades to raw provider IDs

### Changed
- Logging: expected-path debug logs are no longer printed per row — CC Switch raw logs that cannot be associated with a message no longer log at all, ZCode provider-mapping fallbacks and Claude JSONL parse skips are aggregated into one summary per collection (with a count), and directory-watch registration prints one summary per watcher
- Daemon fallback output (pre-startup output, and stdout/stderr on Windows) is now redirected to `logs/daemon-fallback.log` instead of `daemon.out.log` / `daemon.err.log` in the data directory; on macOS, panics after logger startup are merged into the daily rotating log file. Stale legacy fallback files are cleaned up on daemon start, and the fallback file is pruned by age and rotated by size so it cannot grow unbounded
- Custom `log.dir` values that point to a not-yet-existing directory are created before the daemon spawns, so `start` no longer fails in that case; the read-only `status` command never creates directories

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users can update in place with `token-usage update --version v0.1.1-rc.2`; `update` without `--version` keeps resolving only stable releases.

<!-- zh -->
v0.1.1-rc.2 是 v0.1.1 的第二个预发布版。修复 Codex 子代理会话的采集失败、恢复 ZCode 上游缓存格式变化后丢失的 provider 显示名，并交付一轮日志治理：预期路径的刷屏日志被移除或聚合为每轮一条汇总，daemon 兜底输出统一落到 `logs/` 目录、不再单独产生 `daemon.out.log` / `daemon.err.log`。预发布版不会被默认选中，请用 `token-usage update --version v0.1.1-rc.2` 显式升级。

### 修复
- Codex：子代理会话的 `session_meta.payload.source` 为对象（如 `{"subagent":{...}}`）时采集不再失败——字符串与对象两种形态均兼容；session_meta 出现未知字段类型时降级为仅提取 ID，不再整条丢弃。此前被记为「缺少 session ID」错误的会话，重试后即可正常采集
- ZCode：`bots-model-cache.v2.json` 升级 version 2 schema（provider 显示名从顶层 `providers` 数组挪入 `workspaceConfigOptions`）后显示名恢复；两种 schema 均解析，文件无法解析时仍回退 provider 原值

### 变更
- 日志：预期路径的 debug 日志不再逐条打印——CC Switch 无法关联消息的 raw 记录完全不打日志，ZCode provider 映射回退与 Claude JSONL 行解析跳过聚合为每次采集一条汇总（带计数），目录监听注册改为每个 watcher 一条汇总
- daemon 兜底输出（日志初始化前的极早期输出，以及 Windows 上的全周期 stdout/stderr）重定向到 `logs/daemon-fallback.log`，不再在数据目录产生 `daemon.out.log` / `daemon.err.log`；macOS 上日志初始化完成后的 panic 输出并入按日轮转的日志文件。启动时清理旧版遗留的兜底文件，fallback 文件按闲置时间清理、按大小轮转，不会无限增长
- 自定义 `log.dir` 指向尚不存在的目录时会在 daemon 拉起前创建，`start` 不再因此失败；只读的 `status` 命令不创建任何目录

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户可 `token-usage update --version v0.1.1-rc.2` 原地升级；不带 `--version` 的 `update` 仍只解析稳定版。
